review:
A 6x6 candy cluster game with Powernudge. Five or more matching symbols pay, and a cluster of more than 15 can be worth up to 100x.

When a cluster wins in the base game, Powernudge can kick in: reels with winning symbols nudge down one, new symbols drop in at the top, and any new wins pay. Winning spots gain a multiplier during the nudges, +1 each time. Three scatters trigger the bonus. Up to 5,000x, 96.09% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
